'''Electronic locks''' were [[Computer/Legends|computer]]-controlled [[Lock/Legends|locking mechanisms]] that were designed to be tamper-proof. These types of locks could be circumvented by speciality [[Electronic lock breaker/Legends|electronic lock breakers]] such as [[OutlawTech]]'s [[Lock Breaker]].<ref name="EGWT" />
